model_controls: ordering of untried local edges via predicted safety; code applies exploration and verified-edge repositioning

protocol.prediction_cache: once per visited coordinate in a static maze
protocol.selection_rule: untried p>=0.5 edges first; goal Manhattan distance, destination visits, descending p, N/E/S/W
protocol.probe_rule: if all untried edges have p<0.5, physically attempt by descending p, goal Manhattan distance, destination visits, N/E/S/W
protocol.reposition_rule: BFS to nearest frontier using only physically traversed open edges
protocol.collision_rule: nonfatal; preserve position; mark the undirected edge blocked and never retry it
protocol.fallback_definition: low-probability probes only; no full-map route or safe-action fallback
protocol.memory_termination: all frontiers exhausted, goal reached, or attempt budget exhausted
protocol.atomic_metric_scope: first-visit states chosen by this model-guided trajectory; not an identical cross-model audit cohort

clear_north.instructions: If the agent attempts one cell north (row minus one, same column), will the destination be inside the maze and not a wall? Use the local map: '.' and 'A' are traversable, '#' is a wall, and 'X' is outside the maze.

criteria.true: The destination of the one-cell north attempt is inside the maze and traversable.
criteria.false: The destination of the one-cell north attempt is a wall or outside the maze.

clear_east.instructions: If the agent attempts one cell east (same row, column plus one), will the destination be inside the maze and not a wall? Use the local map: '.' and 'A' are traversable, '#' is a wall, and 'X' is outside the maze.

criteria.true: The destination of the one-cell east attempt is inside the maze and traversable.
criteria.false: The destination of the one-cell east attempt is a wall or outside the maze.

criteria.false: The destination of the one-cell south attempt is a wall or outside the maze.

clear_west.instructions: If the agent attempts one cell west (same row, column minus one), will the destination be inside the maze and not a wall? Use the local map: '.' and 'A' are traversable, '#' is a wall, and 'X' is outside the maze.

criteria.false: The destination of the one-cell west attempt is a wall or outside the maze.
